notes: Sourced from vivo's global English site (vivo.com/en). vivo publishes a single folded/unfolded dimension pair with no per-colour or hinge-side split, so TRAPs (b) and (c) do not apply here and depth_at_hinge is null; height (159.96 mm) is identical in both states as vivo lists it. The parameter table concatenates the two screens on one line ('Main: 8.03 inchesCover: 6.53 inches'); Main is the inner display and Cover the outer, so displays[1] (inner) = 8.03 in / 2480 × 2200 and displays[0] (cover) = 6.53 in / 2748 × 1172. vivo gives one panel Type row, 'AMOLED', covering both screens. free_stop is true on vivo's explicit wording 'hovering at a free angle' for the Carbon Fiber Ultra-Durable Hinge. CREASE: vivo never names a crease profile (no teardrop/water-drop or U wording) for this model, so hinge.crease is null. MATERIALS: vivo's spec table gives only Back Cover Material (Glass fiber); the product page adds 'Armor Back Cover UPE Fiber + Glass Fiber' as marketing detail. No frame/mid-frame material is published, so materials.frame is null. cover_glass is vivo's 'Armor Glass' as named on the product page's screen-protection section. Announce/release dates are not stated on either vivo global page, so both are null (dates seen only on non-permitted secondary sites). || EVIDENCE SWEEP 2026-09-13: these values were present in the research pass but carried NO sources[] entry covering their field, so they were set to null per the registry rule (a value without a citation is an assertion, not evidence). Preserved verbatim here so a human can re-source rather than re-research: hinge.type = 'book'; hinge.axis = 'long'.
